metadata.token_ids_note: token ids replaced by their sha256 (token_ids_sha256); only equality is used

dose.rule: attainable max 0.150 < 0.40: d2 = 0.95 x max, d1 = half of max

commit3.rule: ban tokens with committed Pfail >= 0.5 at each dosed node

dose.rule: attainable max 0.188 < 0.40: d2 = 0.95 x max, d1 = half of max
